channel.title: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success
channel.description: A knowledge base dedicated to systematically introducing, explaining, and applying various powerful methodologies, helping people on their path to success.

image.title: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: Value Stream Mapping
item.description: Value stream mapping puts every process step, every wait and the information flow on a single page, exposing the real bottleneck. Learn how to draw current-state and future-state maps, key metrics like process cycle efficiency, a worked example, a template and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: PDCA Cycle
item.description: The PDCA cycle (Plan-Do-Check-Act) drives continuous improvement through four stages that close the loop. Learn what happens in each stage, a fill-in template, three worked examples, how PDCA differs from PDSA, OODA and DMAIC, and the mistakes that break the cycle.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: Value Proposition Canvas
item.description: The Value Proposition Canvas maps customer jobs, pains and gains against your products, pain relievers and gain creators so you can check whether they actually fit. Learn the six blocks, the right order to fill them in, three levels of fit, a template, examples and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: Kano Model
item.description: The Kano model classifies features as must-be, one-dimensional, attractive, indifferent or reverse, so you can prioritize by their effect on satisfaction. Learn the five categories, the two-question survey and evaluation table, Better-Worse coefficients, a worked example and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: Lean Startup
item.description: The Lean Startup treats a new venture as a set of hypotheses to test through Build-Measure-Learn cycles and minimum viable products. Learn validated learning, innovation accounting, the four steps of customer development, types of pivot, an experiment template and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: After Action Review
item.description: An After Action Review turns an experience into reusable knowledge using four questions: what was supposed to happen, what actually happened, why the difference, and what we'll do next time. Includes a meeting agenda, facilitation tips, a template, examples and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: STAR Method
item.description: The STAR method structures an answer as Situation, Task, Action and Result, the standard format for behavioral interviews. Learn how long each part should be, good vs weak answers, a preparation template, use in résumés and reviews, and the six most common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: SCQA Framework
item.description: The SCQA framework builds an opening that makes your audience want your conclusion: situation, complication, question, answer. Learn each element, four ordering variants, before-and-after rewrites, templates for reports and emails, examples and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: Mixed Methods Research
item.description: Mixed methods research combines quantitative and qualitative data in one study to get a fuller answer than either alone. Learn the core designs (convergent, explanatory sequential, exploratory sequential), how to integrate results, a planning template and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: Qualitative Research
item.description: Qualitative research explores experiences, meanings and processes through interviews, observation and texts. Learn the main methods, sample sizes, how to ensure rigor, an interview guide template, how it differs from quantitative research, and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: Quantitative Research
item.description: Quantitative research collects numerical data and uses statistics to describe, find relationships and test hypotheses. Learn the main designs, the research process, sampling and measurement basics, a study plan template, how it compares with qualitative research and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: Cornell Note Taking
item.description: The Cornell note-taking method divides a page into notes, cues and a summary to turn passive notes into active review. Get the page layout and template, the 5 R's process, examples for lectures, meetings and books, digital tips and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: Correlational Research
item.description: Correlational research measures how strongly two or more variables are related without manipulating them. Learn how to interpret correlation coefficients, the main types and methods, why correlation is not causation, a planning template and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: Descriptive Research
item.description: Descriptive research systematically describes what is happening in a population or phenomenon: who, what, when, where and how much. Learn the main methods (surveys, observation, case studies), a design template, how it differs from correlational and experimental research, and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: Experimental Research
item.description: Experimental research tests cause and effect by manipulating an independent variable and controlling other factors, ideally with random assignment. Learn the main designs, a planning template, threats to validity, how A/B tests fit in, and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: Iceberg Model
item.description: The Iceberg Model is a systems thinking tool that looks beneath visible events to patterns, underlying structures and mental models. Learn the four levels, guiding questions, a worksheet, examples and where leverage for change really lies.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: System Dynamics
item.description: System dynamics models how complex systems behave over time through stocks, flows, feedback loops and delays. Learn the core concepts, how to draw causal loop diagrams, common system archetypes, examples like the bullwhip effect, and common modeling mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: Action Research
item.description: Action research combines taking action and studying it in repeated cycles of plan, act, observe and reflect, usually with the people affected. Learn the cycle, a planning template, examples in education and organizations, quality criteria and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: Grounded Theory
item.description: Grounded theory builds theory from qualitative data through open, axial and selective coding, constant comparison and theoretical sampling. Learn the steps, the main schools, a coding example, a memo template and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success

item.title: KPI
item.description: Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are the few metrics that show whether an organization or team is achieving its key objectives. Learn how to choose good KPIs, leading vs lagging indicators, a KPI definition template, examples by function and common mistakes.
item.source: Wisdom Wiki of Methodologies : Way To Success
